description: Verify an agreement certificate by ID, up to 40 characters. Returns the verification service verdict unchanged. A genuine certificate does not guarantee performance. It also shows whether the other party confirmed or disputed: counterparty.state is PENDING, CONFIRMED, DISPUTED, EXPIRED_UNANSWERED or NOT_OFFERED. Use this for agreement certificates; use verify_astranl for every other AstraNL reference.
name: commitment_verify
